kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتقن (form VIII)
# أَحْتَقِنُ (ʔaḥtaqinu) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# أَحْتَقِنَ (ʔaḥtaqina) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# أَحْتَقِنْ (ʔaḥtaqin) /ʔaħ.ta.qin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
